name: Doom Stones
source:
Yuuka, a shy and softspoken girl, loses herself when her best friend Souta passes away.
One day, she's given a chance to redo the night his life was taken.
Perhaps this time, she'll save him.

[From [url=https://lunariamv.tumblr.com/post/741000866734161920]the developer's blog[/url]]
translation:
优香是一个害羞、说话轻声细语的女孩，当她最好的朋友苍太去世时，她失去了自我。
有一天，她得到了重演夺走他生命的那晚的机会。
也许这一次，她能救他。

[来自[url=https://lunariamv.tumblr.com/post/741000866734161920]开发者博客[/url]]
